4711 acqua colonia floral fields of irel.description: Citrusy and balsamic yet sweet and earthy, 4711 Acqua Colonia Floral Fields of Ireland is a 2019 fragrance for men and women. Produced by Maurer & Wirtz, a sister company of famed perfumery 4711, top notes of lemon and mandarin orange welcome your nose to the scent. Following closely behind is the perfume's heart, a white floral combination of jasmine and orange blossom paired with herbal mimosa.

adidas terrex freehiker 3 low gore-tex w.name: adidas Terrex Freehiker 3 Low GORE-TEX White Hiking Shoes
adidas terrex freehiker 3 low gore-tex w.description: Blaze any trail with adidas' Terrex Freehiker 3 Low GORE-TEX hiking shoes clad in a cloud white and black upper with an off-white outsole. Crafted for explorers, these kicks offer GORE-TEX® technology designed for a breathable yet dry shoe alongside its ripstop textile upper that reinforces their durability for a day filled with adventure. Fitted with HyperBoost Pro cushioning for responsive comfort and Continental™ rubber outsoles for superior traction in wet and dry conditions, these shoes come battle-ready to face anything that awaits off the beaten path.

azzaro the most wanted — eau de parfum e.description: The seemingly simple composition of Azzaro The Most Wanted by Azzaro hides a warm, mysterious and playful side that is as complex as the modern man. Released in 2021, this masculine fragrance unpredictably unfolds to create a titillating aroma that is full of vigor. It opens with a spicy yet green and lemony scent of cardamom that is complemented by a smoky and sugary heart of caramel.

Diseñado con sostenibilidad en mente, cada contenedor se fabrica enteramente de vidrio borosilicato premium – más fuerte que el vidrio tradicional y capaz de soportar temperaturas más altas sin grietas – ofreciendo una alternativa libre de plástico, libre de PFAS que es duradero y ligero. Con una variedad de tamaños, este set es perfecto para todo, desde la preparación de la comida y el almuerzo hasta la historia
